title: Design System: Răng Hàm Mặt — Blue Care

nativeWpf.units: XAML numeric dimensions are device-independent units; frontmatter px preserves their numeric values. Frontmatter padding uses CSS order; XAML two-value Thickness uses horizontal,vertical.
nativeWpf.evidence: Source inspection only; no rendered screenshots or runtime visual validation.
nativeWpf.componentPreview: XemTruoc/index.html is an illustrative HTML layout, not a WPF runtime capture.

layout.home: White header, greeting, search/category filters, wrapping white app tiles.
layout.windows: One borderless maximized main window; 19 apps and 16 embedded editor/placeholder controls.

buttonStates.hover: Surface opacity 0.85; accent border. AppTile background becomes White.
buttonStates.keyboardFocus: Accent border thickness 2. AppTile background becomes White.

nativeWpf.inputs: Rounded TextBox/PasswordBox, 42-DIP minimum, accent focus border; ComboBox/DatePicker retain native behavior.
nativeWpf.persistence: Static existing forms; no backend persistence.
nativeWpf.windowStyle: WindowBase: Segoe UI 14, Ink, layout rounding.
nativeWpf.databaseForms: Lists separated from editors; key-column toggle; grouped 270-DIP wrapping fields, 20-DIP gaps. All 245 schema fields preserved.
nativeWpf.revision: Weekly schedule/table switches; independent hospital/warehouse chart panels; doubleclick contextual details and child creation; medicine tab; restricted audit activity types; separate warehouse receipts/payments.

rules.name: The Blue Accent Rule
rules.body: Reuse the named blue brushes for shared accents; do not restore the rejected purple palette.

dos: **Do** reuse the seven brushes, shared native styles, Vietnamese labels and visible keyboard focus.
**Do** retain the Home icon grid, embedded pages and forms and explicit Home return.
donts: **Don't** restore purple or replace Home with a sidebar.
**Don't** imply backend persistence, real authorization or rendered visual validation.
